no_reentrancy_guard_present.meaning: addRewards and claimRewards perform transfers and state changes without a nonReentrant guard

pending_accounting_increased.meaning: pending-reward accounting has already been increased by addRewards
pending_accounting_increased.checkpoint: during addRewards, after accounting update and before external transferFrom completes

transfer_from_completed.meaning: the external transferFrom of addRewards has completed

reentrant_entrypoint_invoked.meaning: claimRewards or another entrypoint is invoked while pending-reward accounting is increased but transferFrom has not completed

reentrancy_window_usable_for_griefing.meaning: a clear reentrancy window exists that can be used for griefing

assumptions: The malicious or reentrant token is the reward asset used by addRewards.
The reentrant call occurs during the external transferFrom of addRewards.

unresolved.description: Report does not state whether the attacker is the caller of addRewards or only controls the token.
Whether claimRewards auth checks currently permit the reentrant call is not established; the report frames unauthorized withdrawal as conditional on future auth changes.

limitations: Impact modality is potential; the pattern encodes the forbidden reentrant invocation as the effect to be absent, not an inevitable outcome.
No concrete amounts, balances, or numeric bounds are given; the relation is expressed with grounded Boolean observables.
Only the selected impact griefing_via_reentrancy is formalized in this claim.
